hospital.lag: A hospital mainly adds emergency capacity, so chronic outcomes move very little. Its value shows up in emergencies such as a heat wave.

clinic.lag: Primary care catches problems early, so visits for care that could have been handled at a clinic fall within a year or two.

mobile_van.lag: A van brings care to people far from a clinic, but with fewer services, so effects are smaller.

supermarket.lag: Diet changes slowly, and chronic disease slower still, so effects appear over years and are modest unless paired with education and economic support.

farmers_market.lag: A weekly market is cheap and quick to start but reaches fewer people, so changes are small.

corner_store.lag: Healthier items in existing stores improve access fast and cheaply, with small long-run effects.

water_upgrade.lag: Safer water cuts waterborne illness within months. Lead exposure also depends on pipes, so it changes less.

lead_replacement.lag: Removing lead pipes lowers children's blood lead slowly, over one to two years, because lead leaves the body slowly.

ymca.lag: More activity and connection lower blood pressure and stress over years, if people can afford and reach the center.

park.lag: Green space invites activity and cuts stress, and trees clean the air a little. Trees take years to grow.

sidewalks.lag: Safe sidewalks make walking a daily habit, which builds up slowly into better heart health.

bus_route.lag: A bus line does not treat anyone, but it brings clinics, jobs, and groceries within reach.

chw_outreach.lag: Trusted health workers help people use the care that exists, so use of preventive care rises within months.

school_clinic.lag: Care at school reaches children without parents missing work, so vaccination and asthma control improve.

nutrition_ed.lag: Education shifts habits slowly, and works best alongside better food access.

insurance_drive.lag: Enrollment help raises coverage within months, and people with coverage use clinics instead of the ER.

mental_health.lag: Counseling lowers stress and poor mental health days within the first year.

factory_controls.lag: Cleaner air lowers children's asthma attacks within a year or two.

tree_buffer.lag: Trees take years to grow, so air benefits arrive slowly.

mixed_income_redevelopment.lag: New market-rate homes raise nearby rents. Over a few years some longtime residents may be priced out.

affordable_housing.lag: Stable, decent housing lowers stress, and homes priced for current residents add little rent pressure.

sugary_tax.lag: A price signal shifts what people buy within a year, and weight changes slowly.

smoke_free.lag: Less secondhand smoke lowers children's asthma attacks gradually.

min_wage.lag: Higher income reduces money stress, and effects on health build slowly.

housing_protection.lag: Tenant protections slow rising rents so fewer residents are pushed out.
